STEP 1 — Scope screening of the four proposals against the frozen bundle (82f9febf / 1096b1ae / 39626c1c / 91d34190).

Read: all four SPECIFICATION blocks; bundle items E1-E3 (behaviour signal + leakage), E12-E14 (curved operation + where it acts), E5-E11 (observed evidence).

Observed: all four name a training-only signal (successor centroid per l1 codeword; row-normalised top-8 successor distribution; popularity-adjusted directed out-degree; Dice-normalised successor distribution over l1 codewords), all name an explicit curved operation (Poincare d_P plus log/exp at level 1; exp_0 + Frechet mean; single fixed kappa = -1/R^2 ball; log/parallel-transport on ball radius sigma), all confine it to level 1 except shalcurv-cont-anchor-rq which also acts on level 0 and on the residual hand-off. All four declare the behaviour-off / geometry-off switch and a one-run observable (valid_l1_hard_er, first-token hit, level2_distinct_prefixes, l3_collision, Stage3 recall > 0.065). My screening verdict: all four pass the scope contract, none is rejection-grade, so the ranking must be on evidence fit, not scope.

Key observed anchors I will use for the ranking:
- E5: successor entropy is strongly stratified, top-1 successor mass 0.4375 (low-entropy bin) vs 0.0543 (high-entropy bin), Spearman -0.973 — a per-item behavioural scalar such as out-degree/branching is genuinely informative and non-degenerate.
- E8: first-level capacity ceiling — canonical pairs sharing a coarse cluster fall monotonically from K=16 (0.3106) to K=256 (0.0822); coarse level-1 behavioural grouping is where the headroom is, deep levels are not.
- E6/E7: the only arms that get near target are the level-1-only Euclidean ones (l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363) with gold prefix alive at depth 2 at 0.829; the l1_br arm collapses to TApi/T2/T3 NLL 0/0/0/9.03 and recall 0.04671.
- E6 again: the successor-geodesic assignment-score arms (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, v2 0.05463) sit BELOW the 0.0555 baseline. This is direct measured evidence against the "add a successor anchor term to the level-1 geodesic score" family.
- E11: same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 — the first prefix carries only weak behavioural signal in the baseline SIDs.

Still open at this step: ordering among the two shallow-only arms that both preserve the baseline residual (brancurv vs SGSA) and the size of the geosuccdrift step.

STEP 2 — Failure-mode audit of each candidate against the depth-localised collapse evidence.

Read again: the M0TIVATION/RISKS of each proposal plus E6/E7 (deep-prefix survival, per-position NLL) and the baseline l3_collision 0.2745 / level2_distinct_prefixes 7414 figures quoted in the proposals.

Observed and reasoned:
1. brancurv-l1-rq — the level-1 codebook parameter stays Euclidean and is subtracted verbatim (res = z - e_{k1}), so the residual cloud handed to levels 2..3 keeps its baseline radial range; only the level-1 argmin is geodesic. This is the one design that structurally cannot shrink residual radial variance, which the proposals themselves identify as the cause of the GEOCAP/OCCURV/strataot collapse (l3_collision 0.549/0.943/0.960, prefixes 4236/784/720). Its curvature is a single measured constant kappa = -1/R^2 with R = log(N_items)/log(1+b_bar) (b_bar measured), so no tuned constant, and the behaviour enters as the radial coordinate r_i = R tanh(T_i/(2R)) inside d_P — removing the behaviour makes r_i constant and changes the argmin; setting kappa -> 0 recovers Euclidean argmin. Real two-way coupling, cost < 1% of a step, no extra loss. Best evidence fit: it buys exactly the coarse behavioural grouping that E8 says is where the headroom is, and it protects the deep levels that E6 says must survive.
2. l1-geosuccdrift-rq — level-1 separation is the stated target and the drift is confined to level 1, matching the "separable problem" reading of the rejected arms. But the drift moves e_{c1} itself, so r2 = z0 - e_{c1} changes and the deep residual distribution is perturbed — the exact failure mode of the rejected arms, only capped. Also its step is eta_t * kappa_c * m_c with eta_t = the optimizer lr: a per-step displacement of order 1e-3 in tangent norm is plausibly a near no-op over a bounded number of steps (the proposal lists "the cap makes it a no-op" as a live risk), and its success signal is a codeword-centroid EMA that can be popularity-dominated (E5 shows top-1 successor mass 0.44 in the low-entropy bin, so hubs will dominate m_c). Ranked second, not first.
3. shalcurv-cont-anchor-rq — the strongest technical construction (level-0 + level-1 geodesics, log-map + parallel transport hand-off, concentration alpha_x instead of a tuned weight, M=8 geometric shortlist). But it deliberately rewrites the residual delivered to levels 2..3 (s1 = v1 - e_{1,k1} with a transported v1) and reconstructs through the curved chart at all levels; E6/E7 show that the arms which disturb the deep input distribution are exactly the ones whose depth-2/3 prefix survival and T4 NLL collapse. Its own risk list names this. High-variance, highest chance of reproducing l3_collision > 0.35. Ranked third.
4. SGSA-RQ-2026 — shallow and safe, but its level-1 score (geodesic item-code distance plus geodesic code-to-successor-Frechet-anchor distance) is the closest match in the bundle to the measured successor_geodesic_coarse family, which scored 0.05500 and 0.05463 against a 0.0555 baseline — i.e. the evidence already contains a near-replication of this mechanism and it did not improve recall. It also fixes c = -1 with no measured scale and freezes D_item/D_anchor at initialisation while the encoder moves, which is a real drift risk the proposal concedes. Ranked last on direct contrary evidence.

Objection to record: the bundle contains no measurement of any of the four exact mechanisms; E6/E7 are beam/teacher-forced probes of adjacent SID variants, no

t the proposed training runs, and E8 says a small K (16-64) is where behavioural co-location pays off while all four candidates keep K1 = 256. The strongest measured arms are level-1-only Euclidean at 0.0621-0.0636, still short of 0.065, so no placement here can be guaranteed to clear the target, and with one run and no ablation the seed noise is comparable to the margin being claimed.

STEP 3 — Final ranking (complete answer, one line per proposal, grounded in the frozen bundle).

RANK: brancurv-l1-rq | position=1 | reason=Only candidate that leaves the deep recursion literally baseline AND verbatim-subtracts the Euclidean level-1 code (res = z - e_k1), which is the direct structural answer to the measured collapse of the deep-curvature arms (l3_collision 0.549/0.943/0.960, level2_distinct_prefixes 4236/784/720 vs baseline 7414); its single measured curvature kappa = -1/R^2 with R from measured b_bar and its behaviour-as-radial-coordinate r_i = R tanh(T_i/2R) give a real two-way coupling at <1% step cost, and E8 (behavioural co-location 0.3106 at K=16 falling to 0.0822 at K=256) says the headroom is exactly in coarse level-1 grouping while E11 (same_first_prefix 0.0907 vs null 0.067) says the baseline prefix under-uses behaviour.
RANK: l1-geosuccdrift-rq | position=2 | reason=Its level-1-only geodesic codeword drift matches the "separable problem" reading of the evidence, but the drift moves e_c1 itself, so r2 = z0 - e_c1 and therefore the deep residual distribution changes — the same deep-input perturbation that the evidence (E6 gold-prefix-alive depth 2 falling to 0.161-0.341; E7 T4 NLL 0.77-1.23) shows accompanies failure; additionally its step eta_t = optimizer lr with a spacing cap risks being a no-op (a risk it lists), and its successor-centroid EMA will be hub-dominated given E5's 0.4375 top-1 successor mass in the low-entropy bin.
RANK: shalcurv-cont-anchor-rq | position=3 | reason=Technically the richest coupling (level-0 + level-1 geodesics, log-map/parallel-transport hand-off, concentration-derived alpha_x, no tuned weight), but it deliberately rewrites the residual handed to levels 2..3 through a transported v1 and reconstructs through the curved chart at all levels — precisely the perturbation that E6/E7 associate with the rejected arms' deep collapse (prefix alive at depth 2 of 0.161/0.122/0.400 and T4 NLL 0.77-1.23 for the curved arms, against 0.829 and 1.23 for the level-1-Euclidean arms that reach 0.062); it carries the highest chance of tripping the l3_collision <= 0.35 condition its own hypothesis sets.
RANK: SGSA-RQ-2026 | position=4 | reason=Its level-1 score is a geodesic item-code distance plus a geodesic code-to-successor-Frechet-anchor distance, which is the closest proposed mechanism to the measured successor_geodesic_coarse family in E6 that scored 0.05500 and 0.05463 — below the 0.0555 baseline — so the bundle already contains near-contrary evidence; it also fixes c = -1 with no measured scale and freezes D_item/D_anchor at initialisation while the encoder keeps moving (a drift its own risk list concedes), leaving no evidence-grounded reason to place it above the three shallow mechanisms that either preserve the deep residual exactly or carry a stronger structural coupling.

OBJECTION: no proposal in this round is measured in the bundle — E6/E7 are beam and teacher-forced probes of adjacent SID variants, and the best measured shallow arms (l1_only 0.06233, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, resample 0.06363) are Euclidean and still short of the 0.065 target, while E8 says behavioural co-location is strongest at K = 16-64 whereas every candidate keeps K1 = 256; so the ranking is a structural/evidence-fit ordering, not a prediction that any of the four clears 0.065, and with one run and no ablation the seed noise is comparable to the claimed margin.
